title: Oppenheimer's late speech on abolishing nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: As Openheimer said in his one of his last speeches that he gave u to his scientists, uh, we can't afford to think that we can't abolish all nuclear weapons.

plain: Oppenheimer is said to have told his scientists, in one of his last speeches, that we cannot afford to think we cannot abolish all nuclear weapons. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas, who says a UFO shut down ten nuclear missiles, quotes this to Michels. He uses it to back the case that nuclear weapons should be done away with.
